fusions.name: Thread the Gap
fusions.desc: A hatchet thrown through the gaps in armour that deals 34 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the maximum range of 7 tiles, ignoring the target's armour.

fusions.name: Tangling Cut
fusions.desc: A cone of cuts that deals 4 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you; each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Mantle
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Fine Seam
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
